problem.description: The same seven falsification outcomes were harvested under two repository identities for a byte-identical lightweight snapshot. Evaluation grouping did not prevent both rows from contributing independently to classifier training and Beta-Binomial rule priors.

decision.scope: Exact aliases only. Related findings with different fingerprints remain distinct observations.
decision.conflict_policy: Fail closed if exact aliases disagree on actionable outcome.
decision.persistence_policy: Retain all immutable label, assessment, feature, score, model-run, finding, and usage rows. Reconcile only their effective statistical contribution.

implementation.training: Family-distinct labels contribute one real row and one unit of effective mass; the selected authoritative label determines the associated stored feature vector.
implementation.priors: Family-distinct labels contribute one Bernoulli observation to the rule posterior and historical false-positive rate.
implementation.store_boundary: A typed RealTrainingExample retains label identity through the SQLite join; the legacy tuple projection remains available.
implementation.classifier_features: Evaluation family remains excluded from classifier features and is used only for leakage control, grouped validation, and exact-alias reconciliation.

authorized_and_completed: read-only corpus assembly and model-selection dry run
authorization_boundary.next_step: After merge, freeze and authorize a zero-provider continuation receipt that re-triages the retained Documenso SARIF under the reconciled corpus, verifies the frozen xgboost identity, then proceeds to exact-commit Lobsters ingest/detect/triage only if Documenso passes.
